covered: v1 src/adapters/kiro/*, hooks/kiro/*, configs/kiro/*, hooks/core/routing.mjs, tool-naming.mjs, session-helpers.mjs with git archaeology

findings.claim: The generated matcher is 'Bash|PowerShell|Read|Grep|WebFetch' + ctx_*. Kiro native tools are execute_bash and fs_read. No doc maps Kiro native names, so a matcher built from the table never fires on Kiro: no hint, no curl/wget/build deny.
findings.evidence: PRD-v2.md:103 'Matchers: `Bash|PowerShell|Read|Grep|WebFetch` + our own `ctx_*`'. v1 hooks/core/routing.mjs:555-557 '"fs_read": "Read", "fs_write": "Write", "execute_bash": "Bash"'; v1 src/adapters/kiro/hooks.ts PRE_TOOL_USE_MATCHERS ['execute_bash','fs_read',...]. grep execute_bash|fs_read over PRD/TECH-SPEC/ADRs: 0 hits.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 98f0025f 2026-03-16 'feat(kiro): add hook support for Kiro CLI (Phase 2)' (TOOL_ALIASES + matchers). ORIGINAL_INTENT: hooks.ts comment 'Kiro native tool names (from TOOL_ALIASES in routing.mjs): execute_bash → Bash, fs_read → Read, fs_write → Write'. REGRESSION_RISK: v2 Kiro adapter silently inert. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: native-name map lives in adapters/table.ts; verify current Kiro CLI V3 names (may differ from legacy q-cli) before freezing.
findings.fix: Add a native tool-name row per agent to the adapter table (TECH-SPEC §3.8 covers MCP names only). Kiro: execute_bash→Bash, fs_read→Read, web fetch name [U]. Add a GP3 fixture with a Kiro execute_bash payload.

findings.claim: v2 keys all state on session_id and injects nothing when it is empty. Kiro session_id presence is unknown, and v1 used a pid fallback on Kiro. No doc says what Kiro does: the fallback is banned (no fallback chains), so Kiro may lose journal, hint-once and compaction state.
findings.evidence: ADR-0009:48 'Every query has `WHERE session_id = :current`. An empty id means nothing is injected.' v1 hooks/session-helpers.mjs:196 KIRO_OPTS 'sessionIdEnv: undefined, // No session ID env var — uses ppid fallback'; :375 'return `pid-${process.ppid}`'. tickets/spike-hooks-verified.md:72 unknowns 'Kiro: ... session_id on PromptSubmit/Post'.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 98f0025f 2026-03-16 'feat(kiro): add hook support for Kiro CLI (Phase 2)' (KIRO_OPTS). ORIGINAL_INTENT: comment 'No session ID env var — uses ppid fallback'. Related 4f6f7cb6 'fix(routing): scope guidance throttle by session, not process.ppid (#298)'. REGRESSION_RISK: dropping ppid with no replacement breaks #298 behaviour on Kiro. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: no fallback chain; one fixed source per agent in the table.
findings.fix: Add a Kiro row to the per-agent session-id table: one source (stdin session_id if the live check shows it) or a documented gap listing the features that are off on Kiro. Add the check to ADR-0012 cases.

findings.claim: Kiro live row needs KIRO_API_KEY (paid plan), against the owner rule 'no API keys for tests'. ADR-0012 has no Kiro line at all, so Kiro has neither a keyless path nor a SKIPPED reason. REVIEW-r2 line 137 listed the other keyed rows but missed Kiro.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:365 '| Kiro | tier 2 | `kiro-cli chat --v3 ...` | KIRO_API_KEY (paid plan only) | path open |'. grep -c -i kiro docs/v2/adr/0012-keyless-live-harness.md = 0. REVIEW-r2.md:137 names Codex, Gemini, Qwen, Copilot CLI, Pi only.
findings.fix: Drop the KIRO_API_KEY cell. In ADR-0012 add Kiro: local kiro-cli login if present, else SKIPPED with reason; cover Kiro with GP3 recorded-payload fixtures.

findings.claim: No doc names the Kiro install or update channel. Kiro installs plugins via Powers (import from GitHub, needs plugin.json or POWER.md, manual update check). Release ADR, skill, ADR-0002 and ADR-0010 never mention Kiro, so /release builds no Kiro artifact.
findings.evidence: tickets/spike-distribution.md:16 '| Kiro | UI only: Powers > Add Custom Power > Import from GitHub (needs `plugin.json` or `POWER.md`) | Yes: MCP, skills, hooks, steering | Manual "Check for updates"'. grep -c -i kiro: ADR-0002=0, ADR-0010=0, ADR-0012=0, ADR-0013=0, .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md=0.
findings.fix: Decide the Kiro channel (Power from the release branch vs written config) in ADR-0002; make /release generate POWER.md from adapters/table.ts if Power is chosen; give ctx_upgrade a Kiro mode (host-managed).

findings.claim: Kiro project source exists only for workspace config; user-level config falls to global mode. v1 installed the MCP entry at user level (~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json). No doc says which file v2 writes, so the default upgrade puts Kiro users into global mode with no project split.
findings.evidence: PRD-v2.md:95-96 'Kiro (project-level config only)' / 'No automatic source — ... Kiro user-level config → G11'. v1 src/adapters/kiro/index.ts:180 'return resolve(homedir(), ".kiro", "settings", "mcp.json")'; :305 fix 'Add context-mode to mcpServers in ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json'.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 4bbbd46a 'fix: platform-specific tool prefixes in configs, Kiro mcp.json rename ...'. REGRESSION_RISK: all Kiro projects share one project key. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: no init command (G11 superseded), so choose at install time.
findings.fix: State the Kiro install target for MCP and the project-source outcome in the adapter table; if user-level, say Kiro runs in fixed global mode.

findings.claim: Kiro cleanup says 'Same rule as Claude Code' (inner hooks), but v1 Kiro entries are flat {matcher, command}. v1 also shipped configs/kiro/agent.json (a whole custom agent named context-mode) and KIRO.md for .kiro/steering; neither is in the footprint.
findings.evidence: ADR-0011:68 '`~/.kiro/agents/default.json` `.hooks.*` flat entries ... | Same rule as Claude Code'; ADR-0011:62 Claude rule 'Remove an inner hook ...'. v1 configs/kiro/agent.json '"name": "context-mode"'; src/adapters/kiro/index.ts:43 'configs/kiro/KIRO.md. Users can copy it into `.kiro/steering/`'. Where users saved agent.json is unverified.
findings.archaeology: 163023a4 2026-05-12 'chore(kiro): mirror external-MCP matcher in configs/kiro/agent.json' — 'so users who install via the configs template (rather than `context-mode upgrade`) also get the external-MCP routing protection'. Template install path is a real v1 channel.
findings.fix: Write a Kiro-specific rule: remove flat entries whose command contains 'context-mode hook kiro' or 'hooks/kiro/'; report (not delete) any ~/.kiro/agents/*.json with name 'context-mode' and any .kiro/steering/KIRO.md.

findings.claim: Kiro PromptSubmit stdout must stay silent (exit 0 stdout goes into context). v1 prints a JSON object on every prompt, which Kiro injects as text. GP3 says 'native stdout' but no case asserts empty stdout for Kiro PromptSubmit.
findings.evidence: tickets/spike-hooks-verified.md:19 '`PromptSubmit` ... stdout (must stay silent)'; :39 'Plain text only: exit 0 stdout → context'. v1 hooks/kiro/userpromptsubmit.mjs:86 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ hookSpecificOutput: { hookEventName: "userPromptSubmit", additionalContext: "" } }))'.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY ff0a9a26 2026-05-03 'fix(14-adapter parity): v1.0.107 — Mickey ROUTING_BLOCK + 30+ verified gaps'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: comment 'Kiro CLI userPromptSubmit accepts JSON output for additionalContext (see docs)' — based on old q-cli docs. REGRESSION_RISK: v2 copying v1 keeps the junk line. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: plain text only on Kiro.
findings.fix: Add GP3 case: Kiro PromptSubmit → stdout empty, exit 0. State in ADR-0001 adapter table that Kiro output is plain text (no JSON).
